# Shape Documentation

> Official technical documentation for Shape, an Ethereum L2 built on the OP Stack and part of the Optimism Superchain.

Mainnet chain ID: 360. Shape Sepolia chain ID: 11011. Gas currency: ETH. Gasback shares 80% of L2 sequencer fees with registered contract owners, excluding L1 data fees.

Links below lead to Markdown generated from the same source as the website. Follow the relevant pages for full context. For current $SHAPE token and governance information, see https://shape.network/token.

## Start Here

- [Welcome](https://docs.shape.network/index.md): Shape is the culture-first L2 built on top of Ethereum to power the new NFT economy.
- [Wallet Setup](https://docs.shape.network/wallet-setup.md): Set up your wallet on Shape.
- [Start Building on Shape](https://docs.shape.network/quick-start/index.md): Shape is an EVM-compatible L2 on the Optimism Superchain. Gasback returns 80% of sequencer fees to contract owners.
- [Network Information](https://docs.shape.network/technical-details/network-information.md): Mainnet and testnet chain IDs, ETH gas currency, RPC endpoints, and explorers.

## Gasback and Fees

- [Gasback](https://docs.shape.network/gasback.md): Claim back 80% of the sequencer fees that users spend interacting with your contracts on Shape.
- [Transaction Fees](https://docs.shape.network/building-on-shape/transaction-fees.md): Learn how network fees work on Shape, what changes them, where they go, and how to estimate them.
- [Registering Your Contract for Gasback](https://docs.shape.network/tutorials/registering-contract-gasback/index.md): Choose dashboard or programmatic contract registration for Gasback.

## Build Applications

- [Connect to Shape](https://docs.shape.network/quick-start/connect-to-shape.md): Shape Mainnet runs on chain ID 360. Shape Sepolia (testnet) runs on chain ID 11011.
- [Deploy a Contract on Shape](https://docs.shape.network/quick-start/deploy-a-contract.md): Deploy a smart contract to Shape Sepolia and verify it on the block explorer using Foundry.
- [Shape Builder Kit for Developers](https://docs.shape.network/building-on-shape/builder-kit.md): The Shape Builder Kit is your go-to starter for crafting dApps on the Shape ecosystem. It's a monorepo with a Next.js frontend (wagmi, viem) and a Hardhat smart contract package, all pre-wired with sensible defaults.
- [Launch an NFT Collection on Shape](https://docs.shape.network/tutorials/mint-nft-collection.md): Deploy an ERC-721 contract to Shape Sepolia, mint an NFT, and verify it on the block explorer.
- [AI Agents on Shape](https://docs.shape.network/building-on-shape/ai.md): Shape MCP, AI integration examples, and agent development guidance.

## Explore and Operate

- [The Stack](https://docs.shape.network/the-stack.md): Dynamic NFT achievements, participation, and medals across the Shape ecosystem.
- [Contract Addresses](https://docs.shape.network/technical-details/contract-addresses.md): Official network infrastructure contract addresses.
- [Run a Node](https://docs.shape.network/technical-details/run-a-node.md): Shape is an OP Stack rollup. Running a Shape node requires two clients that talk over the Engine API and authenticate with a shared JWT secret:
- [Differences between Ethereum and Shape](https://docs.shape.network/building-on-shape/differences-ethereum-shape.md): Shape is EVM equivalent, but has some minor differences.

## Tools and Further Reading

- [Alchemy API](https://docs.shape.network/building-on-shape/alchemy-api.md): Find out what Alchemy tools are available to use on Shape.
- [Assembly](https://docs.shape.network/building-on-shape/onchain-compatible/assembly.md): The Assembly system, built on top of Otoms, is a flexible ERC1155 implementation enabling the creation, crafting, and management of both fungible and non-fungible items on the blockchain. Built with upgradeability in...
- [Onchain Compatible Projects](https://docs.shape.network/building-on-shape/onchain-compatible/index.md): A collection of projects made with interoperability in mind
- [OTOM by Kjetil Golid](https://docs.shape.network/building-on-shape/onchain-compatible/otom.md): Create and experiment with particles called otoms
- [Superchain incentives](https://docs.shape.network/building-on-shape/superchain-incentives.md): Learn about the Superchain incentives available to you as a Shape builder.
- [Account Abstraction](https://docs.shape.network/tools/account-abstraction.md): On Shape, combine AA with Gasback to subsidize your users and recoup 80% of sequencer fees.
- [Bridges](https://docs.shape.network/tools/bridges.md): Bridge ETH and tokens between Ethereum and Shape.
- [Data Indexers](https://docs.shape.network/tools/data-indexers.md): NFT queries, indexing services, and data APIs.
- [Explorers](https://docs.shape.network/tools/explorers.md): Verify your contracts on Shapescan to make them readable. See Deploy a Contract for verification steps.
- [Faucets](https://docs.shape.network/tools/faucets.md): Get free testnet ETH on Shape Sepolia for development.
- [Node Providers](https://docs.shape.network/tools/node-providers.md): Public and provider RPC endpoints for mainnet and testnet.
- [Gelato VRF](https://docs.shape.network/tools/oracles/gelato-vrf.md): Request verifiable randomness from smart contracts using Gelato VRF.
- [Safes & Asset Security](https://docs.shape.network/tools/safes-asset-security.md): Manage high-value assets and team operations securely on Shape.
- [Sybil Resistance](https://docs.shape.network/tools/sybil-resistance.md): Protect your app from bots and sybil attacks while preserving user privacy.
- [Registering via the Dashboard](https://docs.shape.network/tutorials/registering-contract-gasback/dashboard.md): This tutorial will guide you through the process of registering your smart contract for gasback using the Gasback Dashboard UI.
- [Registering Programmatically](https://docs.shape.network/tutorials/registering-contract-gasback/programmatically.md): This tutorial will guide you through the process of registering your smart contract for gasback programmatically. The tutorial walks through 3 different approaches you can use, with full example contracts.
